capacity_note: Measured 25.10.2026: sensor.hausbatterie_kwh = BMS remaining Ah x 51.2 V nominal; full charge reached 310 Ah = 15.87 kWh (Jun/Aug), and kWh/SOC gives 15.84 kWh. Previously user estimate ca. 15 kWh, which made the planner abort above 15 kWh.
notes: No battery wear cost, as explicitly requested.
User confirms PV continues charging the battery when the inverter is off.
User gives approximate nominal battery capacity 15 kWh and inverter output limit 2 kW; not independently measured ratings.
BMS configured total capacity reports 0 Ah; it must not be used as a valid capacity measurement.

Charger AC input measured 1127 W during commissioning; use provisional representative rate 1.13 kW rather than original rounded 1 kW. Not a certified maximum or taper curve. 25% full roundtrip loss remains an unmeasured estimate.
Discharge efficiency comes from the EXISTING RAW_PV formula (AC times 1.192), not independent measurement.
Economic discharge reserve is 10%. Grid charging stops at at most 90%; modeled PV storage may fill physical capacity above that ceiling. Actual BMS limits remain independent.
Half-hour decision blocks reduce quarter-hour mode chatter; first and last partial blocks may be shorter. Physical balances still replay each price interval.
Prefer normal inverter operation when the chronological baseline covers energy demand with 65% of PV and 110% of expected load, subject to inverter power; no fixed summer months.

minimum_savings_eur applies only to incremental grid-charge savings versus the optimized no-charge plan. Preserve existing/PV energy for price peaks even below 0.10 EUR holding gain; no wear cost. Normal mode remains preferred when energy is sufficient under cautious PV/load assumptions or holding offers no gain.

PV forecast: Open-Meteo direct/diffuse radiation (rounded town coordinates, user-approved), calibrated per UTC hour on the 30 nearest-declination measured days; backtest daily MAE 1.12 kWh vs 2.73 climatology (short-lead historical forecasts, optimistic for day-ahead). Falls back to HA x ratio and the seasonal tail model.

Tail prices (3 days): median hourly shape (28 days) plus level anchored on the last complete known day, reverting with persistence 0.3 per day towards the 56-day median daily mean, plus weekday offsets; history reconstructed from energy-charts exchange prices via an exact Tibber fit checked every run. Backtest 2026 hourly MAE 3.77/4.15 ct (Jan-Jun selection / Jul-Oct test) vs 4.06/4.22 previous and 5.65/6.44 flat median; forecast floor 0.173 EUR/kWh per user (fixed tariff parts; negative exchange prices remain possible but are not forecast). Tail PV: own measured PV of the 21 past days with the nearest solar declination (spring/autumn mirror, UTC hour, so shading is included without panel geometry); DWD day cloud picks a quantile of those real day totals, blended 50% because this mapping is uncalibrated. Shaded panels make HA PV forecasts unreliable. DWD vintages are archived for later calibration.

Known Tibber intervals alone authorize date-bound schedules. A seven-day uncertain continuation replaces fixed terminal credit; it simulates hold/serve/recharge without end credit and discounts inventory value for finite demand and PV displacement. Forecast rows never authorize HA charging. Cash and estimated carryover are separate; no proven seasonal price skill is claimed.

controller_commissioned is true after physical transition tests. hardware_confirmed remains false because nominal battery capacity, ratings and manufacturer protection limits were not independently measured or certified.

Planner writes only recommendations; the separate HA controller restores its last permission and real plan expiry after restart. Manual OFF remains OFF. BMS heartbeat after current HA startup is required before operation resumes.
